findings.issue: Removing every analysis consistency check lets record() render supplied evidence while labeling it with the persisted raw analysis digest. Normal summary finalization changes non-summary evidence through display timestamp normalization, and stale source/transcript/visual snapshots are accepted. Render and bind the same raw read, permitting only timestamp display normalization while retaining evidence consistency checks.

The added regression test only asserts True and covers none of issue #101's clamped timestamps, timestamp-coverage speech-only placeholder, reliable control, queue scheduling, or summary finalization acceptance paths. It cannot detect a reverted fix or the newly weakened evidence binding.

summary: Fixed the raw-analysis/report binding regression and replaced the no-op regression test. Reports now render from the exact persisted evidence they hash, accept only timestamp display normalization, and reject stale source, transcript, and visual snapshots; issue #101's three queue/finalization paths have real regression coverage without invalidating existing paid-analysis caches.
